title: Intermediate shift square for pinned right-adjoint tensor comparison
statement: Let f:Z→Y be a proper morphism of Noetherian schemes [def-weil-proper-morphism, def-pc-scheme]. Choose the ambient and open derived categories [def-pc-derived-category] in a common localization universe, derived pullback [def-pc-derived-pullback], derived direct image [def-pc-derived-direct-image], and the shared derived tensor [def-pc-scheme-derived-tensor-structure]. Assume Rf* preserves quasi-coherent objects (hRf), O_Y is quasi-coherent (hO), and Lf*K⊗E is quasi-coherent for quasi-coherent K,E (hTensor). Fix a monoidal pullback structure, a pullback adjunction a, a right adjoint c to the quasi-coherent restriction of Rf*, and its adjunction adj. Put F(K)=Lf*K⊗c(O_Y), lifted to the quasi-coherent full subcategory. Let τ:F→c be a natural transformation satisfying, at every K, the pinned projection-isomorphism and adjunction-mate component formulas of [lem-sc-right-adjoint-tensor-comparison-natural]. Write t_K for its underlying ambient morphism. (1) For every integer n and quasi-coherent A,B with B.obj≅A.obj[n], there exist eF:F(B).obj≅F(A).obj[n] and ec:c(B).obj≅c(A).obj[n] with t_B≫ec.hom=eF.hom≫t_A[n].

proof.text: Reuse the proved private qc_stable theorem of Sheaf.AlgebraicGeometry.RightAdjointTensorComparisonTriangle via a proof-only import all. Its qc_shift helper transports quasi-coherence along the homology shift isomorphism H^m(K[n]) ≅ H^(n+m)(K). Equip the quasi-coherent full subcategory with the induced shift; do not prove these two lemmas again.

Apply lem-sc-right-adjoint-tensor-compatible-exact-structures with the supplied pinned component equations. It supplies shift structures on the ambient-valued F(K)=Lf*K tensor c(O_Y) and G(K)=c(K), and shift compatibility of the ambient transformation. Only its shift part is used.

Compose the given ambient isomorphism B.obj to A.obj[n] with the inverse shift comparison for the full-subcategory inclusion, then lift it to an isomorphism i:B to A[n]. Set eF=F(i) followed by the F shift comparison at A, and ec=G(i) followed by the G shift comparison at A. Naturality of the ambient transformation at i, followed by NatTrans.shift_app_comm and associativity, gives the required equality. These constructions work for every integer n and require no invertibility of components.

theorem rightAdjointTensorComparison_shift
    {Z Y : Scheme.{u}} [IsNoetherian Z] [IsNoetherian Y] (f : Z ⟶ Y) [IsProper f]
    [HasDerivedCategory.{w} (SheafOfModules.{u} (moduleRings Z.toRingedSpace))]
    [HasDerivedCategory.{w} (SheafOfModules.{u} (moduleRings Y.toRingedSpace))]
    [∀ U : Y.Opens,
      HasDerivedCategory.{w} (SheafOfModules.{u} ((moduleRings Y.toRingedSpace).over U))]
    (hRf : ∀ E : schemeDerivedQCohCategory Z,
      schemeDerivedQCohProperty Y ((schemeDerivedDirectImage f).obj E.obj))
    (hO : schemeDerivedQCohProperty Y (𝟙_ (schemeDerivedCategory Y)))
    (hTensor : ∀ (K : schemeDerivedQCohCategory Y) (E : schemeDerivedQCohCategory Z),
      schemeDerivedQCohProperty Z (((derivedPullback f).obj K.obj) ⊗ E.obj))
    [Functor.Monoidal (derivedPullback f)]
    (a : derivedPullback f ⊣ schemeDerivedDirectImage f)
    (c : schemeDerivedQCohCategory Y ⥤ schemeDerivedQCohCategory Z)
    (adj : (schemeDerivedQCohProperty Y).lift
      ((schemeDerivedQCohProperty Z).ι ⋙ schemeDerivedDirectImage f) hRf ⊣ c)
    (τ : (schemeDerivedQCohProperty Z).lift
      ((schemeDerivedQCohProperty Y).ι ⋙ derivedPullback f ⋙
        tensorRight (c.obj ⟨𝟙_ _, hO⟩).obj)
      (fun K ↦ hTensor K (c.obj ⟨𝟙_ _, hO⟩))
      ⟶ c)
    (hτ : ∀ K : schemeDerivedQCohCategory Y,
      ∃ pf : (schemeDerivedDirectImage f).obj
            (((derivedPullback f).obj K.obj) ⊗ (c.obj ⟨𝟙_ _, hO⟩).obj) ≅
          K.obj ⊗ (schemeDerivedDirectImage f).obj (c.obj ⟨𝟙_ _, hO⟩).obj,
        pf.inv = (a.homEquiv _ _)
          ((Functor.Monoidal.μIso (derivedPullback f) K.obj
            ((schemeDerivedDirectImage f).obj (c.obj ⟨𝟙_ _, hO⟩).obj)).inv ≫
            (derivedPullback f).obj K.obj ◁ a.counit.app (c.obj ⟨𝟙_ _, hO⟩).obj) ∧
        τ.app K = ((adj.homEquiv
          ⟨((derivedPullback f).obj K.obj) ⊗ (c.obj ⟨𝟙_ _, hO⟩).obj,
            hTensor K (c.obj ⟨𝟙_ _, hO⟩)⟩ K)
          (ObjectProperty.homMk (pf.hom ≫
            K.obj ◁ (adj.counit.app ⟨𝟙_ _, hO⟩).hom ≫ (ρ_ K.obj).hom)))) :
    (∀ (A : schemeDerivedQCohCategory Y) (n : ℤ)
      (B : schemeDerivedQCohCategory Y), Nonempty (B.obj ≅ A.obj⟦n⟧) →
      ∃ (eF : ((derivedPullback f).obj B.obj ⊗ (c.obj ⟨𝟙_ _, hO⟩).obj) ≅
          (((derivedPullback f).obj A.obj ⊗ (c.obj ⟨𝟙_ _, hO⟩).obj)⟦n⟧))
        (ec : (c.obj B).obj ≅ (c.obj A).obj⟦n⟧),
        (τ.app B).hom ≫ ec.hom =
          eF.hom ≫ (shiftFunctor (schemeDerivedCategory Z) n).map (τ.app A).hom)
